name: transcribe-frame-preview
description: Show the video frame for the transcript row under the cursor.

commands.title: Transcribe: Show frame for current row

transcribeFrames.shotsRoot.description: Directory holding <tsv stem>/<start>.jpg, relative to the workspace root unless absolute.

transcribeFrames.follow.description: Update the panel as the cursor moves.

transcribeFrames.hover.description: Also show the frame when hovering a row. Off by default: the panel already follows the cursor, so hovers are mostly in the way.
